mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, face_vector_id, login_type, avatar_url, status, created_at, updated_at, last_login_time FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}) LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id, username, email, phone, password_hash, face_vector_id, login_type, avatar_url, status, created_at, updated_at, last_login_time FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, status, login_type, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{loginType}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, role_id FROM roles WHERE role_name = 'USER' ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT vector_id, user_id, face_vector, face_image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM face_vectors WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_name FROM user_roles ur JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_id
